title: AeroFlow workload manifest
description: Request for paved-road infrastructure (ADR-0009). Not a deployment. Unknown keys are rejected, including any raw resource, Bicep or ARM block.

modules.description: Optional exact module pins in Bicep colon form (ADR-0009). Either br/platform:<module>:<semver> or br:ghcr.io/aeroflow-air/<module>:<semver>. Not a capability-to-module map. The only key ADR-0009 names is hosting.

hosting.description: Bicep registry pin. Either the ADR-0009 alias form br/platform:<module>:<major>.<minor>.<patch>, or br:ghcr.io/aeroflow-air/<module>:<major>.<minor>.<patch>. The module name is not fixed to container-app-service. The tag is numeric major.minor.patch with no leading v and no pre-release. No other registry is accepted.
